sentences.en: Your question does not bear on the subject under discussion.
sentences.zh: 你的问题与当前讨论的主题无关。

sentences.en: The reformers were subject to every attack from the Establishment.
sentences.zh: 改革者遭到了体制的每一个攻击。

sentences.en: A man of strong will is not subject to corruption.
sentences.zh: 意志坚强的人不会受腐败的影响。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：sub（下）+ject（扔）→扔下去（让大家讨论）→主题
